description: This PHP file defines the ChartsDashlet class, which extends the Dashlet class, providing functionality for displaying, configuring, and refreshing a chart dashboard widget within the SuiteCRM or SugarCRM system. It includes methods for rendering the dashlet's HTML, its associated JavaScript, and handling configuration options.

classes.name: ChartsDashlet
classes.description: A class representing a dashboard widget (dashlet) that displays charts based on reports, with methods to render, configure, and refresh the chart dashlet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dashlet with given ID, report ID, and options, setting properties for configuration and scripting.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML output for rendering the dashlet, including report retrieval, chart rendering, and embedding chart scripts.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Outputs the JavaScript required for the dashlet, primarily for handling the chart display.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Placeholder method for rendering configuration options for the dashlet.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Placeholder method for processing and saving configured options submitted by the user.

methods.name: setConfigureIcon
methods.description: Returns HTML for the configuration (edit) icon in the dashlet if it is configurable.

methods.name: setRefreshIcon
methods.description: Returns HTML for the refresh icon if the dashlet is refreshable, enabling dynamic content refresh.
